units.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Cpp reads and writes PDF documents, extracts text, converts pages to images, and manages document metadata, encryption, and permissions. It supports reading encrypted files when provided with a user or owner password and writing encrypted files using AESx256 encryption. It exposes classes for document information, text absorption, and rendering via devices such as PNG output. It operates without external dependencies and is implemented in C++.

It opens existing PDF files with Aspose.Pdf.Document, supports password-protected files by passing the user or owner password to the constructor, and reports encryption status via IsEncrypted(); it also allows editing document information through Document.Info() and saving changes with Document.Save().

It extracts text from documents or individual pages using Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextAbsorber, and renders pages to raster images in PNG, JPEG, BMP, or TIFF formats through Aspose.Pdf.Devices.PngDevice, JpegDevice, BmpDevice, and TiffDevice with configurable resolution and color depth.

It encrypts documents using Document.Encrypt() with algorithms including RC4-40, RC4-128, AES-128, or AES-256, and controls permissions such as printing, modifying, extracting, and annotating via Aspose.Pdf.Permissions flags; it also supports signing documents with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSignature using detached PKCS#7 signatures.

It builds documents from scratch using positioned text via Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextBuilder and TextFragment, tabular layout with Aspose.Pdf.Table including column widths, borders, and background colors, vector shapes through Aspose.Pdf.Drawing.Graph, and interactive AcroForm fields via Aspose.Pdf.Forms.Form.

It adds and manages annotations such as highlight, underline, text sticky notes, links, stamps, and file attachments through Aspose.Pdf.Annotations, and creates interactive form fields like text boxes, checkboxes, and combo boxes using Aspose.Pdf.Forms.Form with support for flattening fields into static content.

It reads and writes document metadata through typed Aspose.Pdf.DocumentInfo accessors for title, author, subject, keywords, creator, and producer, plus custom entries via Add/Remove/ClearCustomData, and accesses XMP metadata using Aspose.Pdf.Metadata.
This example opens a PDF file, prints the page count, extracts all text, and renders the first page as a PNG image at 150 DPI.
The following workflows demonstrate opening encrypted files, reading and updating document metadata, and applying AES-256 encryption.
Open a password-protected PDF document.
Read and update document metadata.
Encrypt a document with AES-256.
Include the main header for Aspose.PDF FOSS for Cpp.

Aspose.PDF FOSS for Cpp exposes the Aspose.Pdf.Document class as the primary entry point for loading, creating, and saving PDF documents. It provides access to page collections, document information, forms, and other core features through its members.

The Aspose.Pdf.Document class supports opening existing PDFs, creating new documents, encrypting or decrypting files, and saving to disk; it exposes collections for pages, outlines, embedded files, and named destinations, and provides access to form, metadata, and document info objects.

The Aspose.Pdf.Text namespace provides text extraction capabilities via Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextAbsorber and Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextFragmentAbsorber, which visit document pages and populate text or fragment collections for inspection.

The Aspose.Pdf.Devices namespace includes rendering devices such as Aspose.Pdf.Devices.PngDevice, which converts a document or page to an image stream, and Aspose.Pdf.Devices.Resolution, which defines horizontal and vertical DPI settings.

The Aspose.Pdf.CryptoAlgorithm enum lists supported encryption algorithms including RC4x40, RC4x128, AESx128, and AESx256, while Aspose.Pdf.Permissions is a flags enum that controls allowed operations per ISO 32000-1 §7.6.3.2 Table 22.

The Aspose.Pdf.Annotations namespace provides the base Aspose.Pdf.Annotations.Annotation class and per-page Aspose.Pdf.Annotations.AnnotationCollection, with concrete subtypes for highlight, text, free text, stamp, link, ink, and redaction annotations.
The Aspose.Pdf.Forms namespace exposes the Aspose.Pdf.Forms.Form class for managing AcroForm fields and subtypes such as Aspose.Pdf.Forms.TextBoxField, CheckboxField, and RadioButtonField.
The Aspose.Pdf.Drawing namespace includes Aspose.Pdf.Drawing.Graph for vector graphics, and shapes such as Aspose.Pdf.Drawing.Rectangle, Circle, and Line that can be added to pages.

The Aspose.Pdf.Facades namespace provides high-level utilities including Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSignature for detached PKCS#7 signing and Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfConverter for rasterising PDFs to multi-page TIFF or per-page PNG.
It adds full support for every Facades method (including PdfFileEditor and PdfFileStamp), complete XMP type-checking, and broader format coverage beyond this FOSS edition's v1 scope.

Form class provides methods to manage form fields including adding, deleting, calculating, and setting default appearance.
FormType enum lists the Dynamic, Standard, and Static form types.
IconCaptionPosition enum lists the CaptionAboveIcon, CaptionBelowIcon, CaptionOverlaid, CaptionToTheLeft, CaptionToTheRight, NoCaption, and NoIcon positions.
IconFit class provides methods to manage icon scaling mode and scaling reason.
ListBoxField class provides methods to manage list box fields including top index.
NumberField class provides methods to manage allowed characters and number field behavior.
Option class provides methods to manage option index, name, selection status, and value.
OptionCollection class provides methods to manage a collection of options including adding, clearing, removing, and checking containment.
PKCS1 class provides a method to manage PKCS#1 digital signatures.
PKCS7 class provides a method to manage PKCS#7 digital signatures.
PKCS7Detached class provides a method to manage detached PKCS#7 digital signatures.
PasswordBoxField class provides a method to manage password box fields.
RadioButtonField class provides methods to manage radio button fields including adding options, position, style, and toggle behavior.
RadioButtonOptionField class provides methods to manage radio button option name and style.
RichTextBoxField class provides methods to manage formatted value, justification, rich text value, and style.
ScalingMode enum lists the Anamorphic and Proportional scaling modes.
ScalingReason enum lists the Always, IconIsBigger, IconIsSmaller, and Never scaling reasons.
Signature class provides methods to manage signature authority, contact information, location, reason, custom appearance, and byte range.

SignatureCustomAppearance class provides methods to manage signature appearance including background color, contact info label, date signed label, date time format, digital signed label, digital subject format, and font family name.
SignatureField class provides methods to sign and manage signature appearance.
SubjectNameElements enum lists the C, CN, E, L, O, OU, and S subject name elements.
Symbology enum lists the DataMatrix, PDF417, and QRCode barcode symbologies.

TextBoxField class provides methods to manage text box properties including barcode addition, comb forcing, maximum length, multiline behavior, scrollability, spell check, vertical alignment, and value.
Aspose.Pdf.Forms.XFA class provides access to XFA field names and the XFA data through its FieldNames and XFA methods.
Aspose.Pdf.GraphInfo class holds graph rendering attributes including Color, DashArray, DashPhase, FillColor, IsDoubled, LineWidth, and RotationAngle.
Aspose.Pdf.HorizontalAlignment enum lists the Center, FullJustify, Justify, Left, None, and Right horizontal alignment values.
Aspose.Pdf.Hyperlink class provides a constructor to create a hyperlink object.
Aspose.Pdf.IIndexBitmapConverter interface provides methods Get1BppImage, Get4BppImage, and Get8BppImage to convert indexed bitmaps.
Aspose.Pdf.LoadOptions class provides a constructor and the DisableFontLicenseVerifications option for loading PDF documents.
Aspose.Pdf.MarginInfo class holds margin values for Bottom, Left, Right, and Top sides.
Aspose.Pdf.Metadata class provides methods Add, Clear, Contains, ContainsKey, Count, GetNamespaceUriByPrefix, GetPrefixByNamespaceUri, and IsFixedSize to manage document metadata.
Aspose.Pdf.NamedDestinationCollection class provides methods Add, Count, Names, and Remove to manage named destinations.
Aspose.Pdf.NumberingStyle enum lists the LettersLowercase, LettersUppercase, None, NumeralsArabic, NumeralsRomanLowercase, and NumeralsRomanUppercase numbering styles.
Aspose.Pdf.OutlineCollection class represents the collection of outlines in a PDF document.
Aspose.Pdf.OutlineItemCollection class provides methods Action, Bold, Destination, HasNext, Insert, Italic, Level, and Next to manage outline items.
Aspose.Pdf.Outlines class provides methods Add, Clear, Contains, Count, Delete, First, IsReadOnly, and Last to manage the outline tree.
Aspose.Pdf.Page class provides methods AddImage, Annotations, ArtBox, Artifacts, BleedBox, CropBox, GetPageRect, and MediaBox to access page content and properties.
Aspose.Pdf.PageCollection class provides methods Add, Count, Delete, Insert, and PageCollection to manage pages in a document.
Aspose.Pdf.PageCoordinateType enum lists the CropBox and MediaBox coordinate type values.
Aspose.Pdf.PageLabel class provides methods NumberingStyle, Prefix, and StartingValue to define page labeling.
Aspose.Pdf.PageLabelCollection class provides methods GetLabel, GetPages, RemoveLabel, and UpdateLabel to manage page labels.
Aspose.Pdf.PageSize class provides methods A0, A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, and B5 to access standard page sizes.
Aspose.Pdf.Paragraphs class provides methods Add, Clear, Count, Insert, Remove, and RemoveRange to manage paragraph objects.
Aspose.Pdf.PasswordType enum lists the Inaccessible, None, Owner, and User password type values.
Aspose.Pdf.PdfFormat enum lists the PDF_A_1A, PDF_A_1B, PDF_A_2A, PDF_A_2B, PDF_A_2U, PDF_A_3A, PDF_A_3B, PDF_A_3U, PDF_A_4, PDF_A_4E, PDF_A_4F, and PDF_E_1 format values.

Aspose.Pdf.Permissions enum lists the AssembleDocument, ExtractContent, ExtractContentWithDisabilities, FillForm, ModifyContent, ModifyTextAnnotations, PrintDocument, and PrintingQuality permission values.
Aspose.Pdf.Point class provides methods Distance, Trivial, X, and Y to represent a point in two-dimensional space.
Aspose.Pdf.Rectangle class provides methods Center, Contains, ContainsLine, ContainsPoint, Empty, Equals, Height, and Intersect to represent and query rectangles.

Aspose.Pdf.RenderingOptions class provides methods AnalyzeFonts, BarcodeOptimization, ConvertFontsToUnicodeTTF, DefaultFontName, HeightExtraUnits, IgnoreResourceFontErrors, InterpolationHighQuality, and MaxFontsCacheSize to control rendering behavior.
Aspose.Pdf.Resources class provides methods Images and Resources to access page resources.
Aspose.Pdf.Rotation enum lists the None, on180, on270, and on90 rotation values.
Aspose.Pdf.Row class provides methods BackgroundColor, Border, Cells, DefaultCellBorder, DefaultCellPadding, DefaultCellTextState, FixedRowHeight, and IsInNewPage to manage table row properties.
Aspose.Pdf.Rows class provides methods Add, Count, IndexOf, Remove, RemoveAt, RemoveRange, and Rows to manage table rows.
Aspose.Pdf.SvgLoadOptions class provides the AdjustPageSize method to control page sizing when loading SVG content.

Aspose.Pdf.Table class provides methods Alignment, BackgroundColor, Border, ColumnWidths, DefaultCellBorder, DefaultCellPadding, DefaultCellTextState, and DefaultColumnWidth to manage table properties.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.Encoding class provides methods BigEndianUnicode, CodePage, Encoding, GetByteCount, GetBytes, GetCharCount, GetEncoding, and GetString to handle text encoding.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.Font class provides methods BaseFont, FontName, IsEmbedded, and IsSubset to represent font properties.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.FontRepository class provides methods FindFont and OpenFont to locate and open fonts.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.Position class provides methods XIndent and YIndent to specify text position.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextAbsorber class provides methods HasErrors, Text, TextAbsorber, and Visit to extract text from a document.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextBuilder class provides methods AppendParagraph and AppendText to build text content on a page.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextFragment class provides methods Position, Rectangle, Text, TextFragment, and TextState to represent a fragment of text.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextFragmentAbsorber class provides methods TextFragments and Visit to extract text fragments from a document.
TextFragmentCollection class holds a collection of text fragments and exposes a Count method to retrieve the number of items.
TextFragmentState class provides state settings for text fragments and exposes a constructor to initialize its instance.

TextParagraph class represents a paragraph of text and exposes methods such as AppendLine, FirstLineIndent, HorizontalAlignment, Margin, Position, Rectangle, SubsequentLinesIndent, and VerticalAlignment.

TextState class defines text formatting properties and exposes methods such as BackgroundColor, CharacterSpacing, Font, FontSize, ForegroundColor, HorizontalAlignment, HorizontalScaling, and Invisible.
VerticalAlignment enum lists the Bottom, Center, None, and Top vertical alignment options.
WatermarkArtifact class represents a watermark artifact that can be added to a page.
XImage class represents an image and exposes methods such as ContainsTransparency, GetRawImageData, Height, ImageMask, Name, and Width.
XImageCollection class manages a collection of XImage objects and exposes methods such as Add, Clear, Contains, Count, Delete, GetImageName, Names, and Remove.

XmpValue class represents an XMP value and exposes methods such as IsArray, IsDouble, IsInteger, IsString, ToArray, ToDouble, ToInteger, and ToString, while IsDateTime, IsField, IsNamedValue, IsNamedValues, IsRaw, and IsStructure always return false.
